summary.text: Amanda Carter James, a write-in independent candidate and Cartersville native, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Georgia's 11th Congressional District to John Cowan.
She has worked 35 years for Shaw Industries, currently as a Senior Fabrication Manager in product development, and has been a registered mediator for 12 years.

paragraphs.text: James describes herself as a lifelong Georgian and Cartersville native, a mother of three and a grandmother of one.

She graduated from Cartersville High School in 1985, attended Florida A&M University, and earned a B.S. in Political Science with a concentration in Public Service and Policy from Kennesaw State University in 2015, according to Ballotpedia.
James has worked 35 years for Shaw Industries, currently as a Senior Fabrication Manager for Hard Surface in Product Development, and has been a registered mediator for 12 years.
She was a write-in independent candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She lost to John Cowan, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
